slides.h: ANIMALS REVIEWED [[DROP DAY]]. HUMANS CAMPED OUTSIDE FOR A {{WATCH}}.
slides.tease: **The dog gave the queue 5 stars.** The cat's review closes the case.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.title: BEST QUEUE EVER
slides.body: Waited nine hours with 400 strangers. Made 400 friends. Forgot what we were buying.

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.title: Excellent standing around
slides.body: I do this on a ledge every day for free. Humans finally get it. Proud of you all.

slides.name: The Raccoon
slides.title: Incredible business model
slides.body: Bought two. Sold one at triple price to the guy behind me. He was also in the queue. He knows what he did.

slides.name: The Sloth
slides.title: Review pending
slides.body: Left home when the drop was announced. Arrived at the restock. Will finish this review by the next one.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.title: It tells the time
slides.body: Your phone tells the time. You slept on concrete. One star, and the star is for the concrete.
Tag the friend who camps every drop.
